name: Hannah Trever
bio: Hannah Trever is a dancer, teacher, dance school owner, adjudicator, promoter and sequence dance creator, and the chair of the Dance Promotions Association, where she started out as treasurer.
about: In this episode, Marius Iepure sits down with Hannah Trever, chair of the Dance Promotions Association, for a conversation about leadership and how UK DanceSport governance works from the inside. She started dancing at four, came into the DPA as treasurer and, without warning, was told by her own committee that she would be its next chair.

They talk about why the DPA is no longer part of the BDC and now stands alone with its own system, licences and amateur members, the three UK leagues, judge licences and adjudicator training, and why dancers should give feedback. Then being a woman leading in a male-dominated industry, safeguarding and confidential reporting, rapid fire questions, Nauru in the World Atlas, the £5 membership and training days, why you keep seeing the same judging panels, the future of the national league, getting more children dancing, and how to build trust in the system.
teaser: Hannah Trever on taking the DPA out of the BDC, leading as a woman and rebuilding trust in UK DanceSport.
